method: Loopback fake peer only; no provider traffic. Python client, scheduling and fake-peer overhead included. TCP reconnects every 8 queries. Queue scenarios send one burst before multiplexed receive; memory is the proxy process only, sampled every 5ms (brief peaks can be missed). Latency percentiles include only successful expected-RCODE replies; failures are counted separately. Queue scenarios use two proxy workers and a peer with concurrent 20ms delayed replies.
